description: This file is a PHP source code implementing the nusoap library, which provides functionality for SOAP web services including client, server, and fault handling. It contains class definitions for nusoap_base, nusoap_fault, and soap_fault, as well as multiple functions related to SOAP message serialization and XML handling. The comments indicate modification history, licensing info, and support details for the NuSOAP toolkit.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: Base class providing core SOAP serialization, namespace handling, debugging, and error management functionalities for the NuSOAP toolkit.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the nusoap_base object and sets the debug level.

methods.name: getGlobalDebugLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the global debug level for all instances.

methods.name: setGlobalDebugLevel
methods.description: Sets the global debug level for all instances.

methods.name: getDebugLevel
methods.description: Returns the debug level for this specific instance.

methods.name: setDebugLevel
methods.description: Sets the debug level for this instance.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Appends debug messages with timestamps and class info.

methods.name: appendDebug
methods.description: Adds debug data to the debug string.

methods.name: clearDebug
methods.description: Clears the debug string.

methods.name: getDebug
methods.description: Returns the current debug string.

methods.name: getDebugAsXMLComment
methods.description: Returns debug data formatted as an XML comment.

methods.name: expandEntities
methods.description: Expands special characters into XML entities, with cleaning for control characters.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns current error message if any.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error message.

methods.name: isArraySimpleOrStruct
methods.description: Determines if an array is a simple list or an associative struct.

methods.name: serialize_val
methods.description: Serializes PHP values into SOAP-compliant XML with type annotations.

methods.name: serializeEnvelope
methods.description: Constructs the full SOAP envelope wrapping the body and headers.

methods.name: formatDump
methods.description: Deprecated method to format strings for HTML display.

methods.name: contractQname
methods.description: Converts a qualified name to a prefixed form with namespace.

methods.name: expandQname
methods.description: Expands a prefixed name into its namespace URI and local part.

methods.name: getLocalPart
methods.description: Extracts local part of a prefixed QName.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix part of a QName.

methods.name: getNamespaceFromPrefix
methods.description: Returns namespace URI for a prefix.

methods.name: getPrefixFromNamespace
methods.description: Returns prefix for a namespace URI.

methods.name: getmicrotime
methods.description: Returns a timestamp string with microseconds.

methods.name: varDump
methods.description: Returns var_dump output as string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes schema and xml files, and parses them if provided.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parse an XML file given its URI.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parse an XML string or file content with appropriate handlers.

methods.description: Generate a type name for unnamed types based on scope.

methods.name: schemaStartElement
methods.description: Handler for start of an XML Schema element, building internal type definitions.

methods.description: Handler for end of an XML Schema element, finalizing type definitions.

methods.description: Handler for character data inside schema elements.

methods.name: serializeSchema
methods.description: Serialize the internal schema definition into XML format.

methods.name: xdebug
methods.description: Add debug information about schema parsing.

methods.name: getPHPType
methods.description: Get PHP type mapping for a user-defined schema type.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Retrieve a type definition array for a given type name.

methods.name: serializeTypeDef
methods.description: Serialize a type definition into an XML string (deprecated).

methods.name: addComplexType

methods.description: Add a new simple type to the schema.

methods.description: Add an element to the schema.

classes.name: nusoap_server

methods.description: Initializes server, WSDL, and debug settings.

methods.description: Processes incoming SOAP requests, handles WSDL requests, and generates SOAP responses.

methods.name: parse_http_headers
methods.description: Parses incoming HTTP headers, extracting content-type, SOAPAction, and encoding.

methods.name: parse_request
methods.description: Parses the request XML payload into a SOAP structure.

methods.name: invoke_method
methods.description: Invokes the appropriate PHP function or class method based on parsed SOAP data.

methods.name: serialize_return
methods.description: Serializes PHP method return data into SOAP envelope XML.

methods.name: send_response
methods.description: Sends the SOAP response over HTTP headers and payload.

methods.name: verify_method
methods.description: Verifies the method call against WSDL or registered methods.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a PHP function or class method as a SOAP operation.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets a fault object to be returned to the client.

methods.name: configureWSDL
methods.description: Sets up WSDL description and schemas for the service.
